newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo Energy in secondary, TECONS sale.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo Energy in secondary, TECONS sale.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Co said Wednesday it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a secondary offering of 1.86 million shares of common stock and to sell $100 million of Term Convertible Securities (TECONS).

The company will use proceeds of the TECONS offering, led by both J.P. Morgan and Salomon Brothers, to pay down debt, although it will not receive any proceeds from the secondary offering, which J.P. Morgan will manage, it said.

Torchmark Corp's United Investors Management Co unit and the 1818 Fund, managed by Brown Brothers Harriman, will sell their Nuevo shares in the secondary offering. United is selling as part of a liquidation of its energy-related investments and the 1818 Fund is selling to adhere to its own holding requirements, Nuevo said.
Nuevo officials were not immediately available to comment.
